claim: An in vivo CRISPR screening pipeline in mouse neuroinflammation was reported to perturb cytokine receptors and signaling molecules in editable progenitor-derived CNS myeloid populations with single-cell and functional readouts.
future_grounding_route: Use only as proof-of-method context. Any project route requires predeclared human-relevance criteria, replicated perturbation directions, functional repair/damage readouts, and an explicit species-transfer falsification gate.
